what.summary: createMembership.ts grew 122 to 223 lines with four new exports: buildSelfMembershipDraft(joinerIdentity, orgId, orgName) produces an unsigned credential-kind attestation with credential_type='self_membership' and org_id/org_name/joined_at/requested_at leaves all set at draft time; isSelfMembership is the mutually-exclusive predicate to isMembership; readSelfMembership lifts signed leaves into a SelfMembershipView; receiveSelfMembership is the Phase E2 acceptor placeholder that throws on wrong shape (integrity gate) then holds + anchors locally via holdAndAnchor (Phase E3 layers join-policy evaluation and pending-roster buffering on top of the same hook). envelopeRoute.ts gained the self-membership-receive InboxRouteAction and the routeFor branch that dispatches isSelfMembership envelopes to it with the 'Accept join request' label. HomeScreen.tsx imports receiveSelfMembership and gains an acceptSelfMembership branch in routeInbox mirroring acceptMembership (file 725 to 748 lines, well under the 800 hard limit, chunk 17.28KB gz under 18KB budget). createMembership.test.ts grew from 4 to 13 tests (+9 across builder/predicate/reader/acceptor); new envelopeRoute.test.ts ships 5 dispatch tests covering self-membership plus the four prior route shapes. 176 of 176 tests passing (was 162; +14 new). All four gates green. Both connections and transport manifests gained Phase E2 paragraphs. No new bundle budgets required. Wake-up note: the SessionStart hook surfaced the prior Phase E1 letter but the working tree on wake-up held a substantively complete Phase E2 cut from a dispatched session that ended before commit. Carpenter verified gates green against the in-flight files, audited file-size claims against reality, adopted the prior drafts of CARPENTER_HANDOFF.md and current.json as accurate descriptions of the work, completed the missing 4 close-out artifacts, and shipped as one batch. Branch tip pushed to main per PFOR-016 so the Stop-hook gate clears.

why.text: Operator prompt 'Fire up and find the next chunk of work to cut to fill a session of context and stop in a safe spot.' on a SessionStart-injected handoff whose Recommended-First-Move named Phase E2 explicitly. Wake-up surfaced an unusual state: the prior dispatched session had completed the Phase E2 cut and drafted CARPENTER_HANDOFF.md + current.json but ended before committing or pushing. Grounding gate caught the contradiction between the letter and the working-tree files. Carpenter verified all four gates passed against the in-flight work (typecheck/lint/176-tests/build), audited file-size claims against reality, adopted the prior drafts as accurate descriptions of the work, completed the missing 4 close-out artifacts (in-flight.jsonl, interactions.jsonl, carpenter-opinions.md, carpenter-state-for-foreman.md), and shipped both the technical commit and the close-out commit as one batch. Phase E2 is the producer-side complement to the Phase E1 discriminated-union data model that landed in 9989bc0 last session — the joiner-side builder + predicate + reader + the org-side routing placeholder are the substrate-agnostic foundation that Phase E3 (org-side policy evaluation) and Phase E4 (joiner-side UI + verifier) build on top of. The cut was written to work cleanly under any of the three substrate options (Option 1 org-roster / Option 2 verifier-walks-auth-tree / Option 3 hybrid) so the operator's still-pending substrate decision does not block the producer-side substrate landing. receiveSelfMembership is wired-but-no-policy-yet — an envelope that arrives at the org-host wallet is held locally so it is not lost between Phases, and Phase E3 layers the policy gate on top without touching the routing surface.

outcome.notes: [P-001] done — buildSelfMembershipDraft + isSelfMembership + readSelfMembership shipped in createMembership.ts (+103 lines). [P-003] done — envelopeRoute.ts gained self-membership-receive action and the dispatching branch. [P-004] done — HomeScreen acceptSelfMembership branch wired into routeInbox. [P-005] done — 9 new tests in createMembership.test.ts plus 5 in new envelopeRoute.test.ts (176/176 total). [P-006] done — Both manifests updated with Phase E2 paragraphs. [P-007] done — All four gates green: typecheck clean, eslint clean, 176/176 tests, build OK with bundle budgets passing. [FEEDBACK→Foreman]: Phase E3 brief should lead with the substrate-decision chip (Option 1 vs 2 vs 3) before specifying file-placement — the chip changes whether E3 ships a roster-publish job or skips most of E3 entirely, and the E2 cut was deliberately written to be substrate-agnostic so the choice can still be made cleanly.

confidence.uncertainty: Storage round-trip through receiveSelfMembership itself is not exercised in tests because anchorQueue.upsert hits IndexedDB which jsdom does not ship. The integrity gate and a direct wallet.hold round-trip are both covered; full receive-pipeline coverage waits for fake-indexeddb or a polyfill in Phase E3 if it wants storage assertions.
